ownership.path: WCN3990 UART -> Android HIDL IBluetoothHci/default -> bluebinder -> /dev/vhci -> one Linux hci controller -> BlueZ
forbidden: BlueZ or hciattach opening the physical WCN3990 UART directly while the Android HAL runs
more than one bluebinder process or Linux HCI controller for the internal radio

source_facts: The UBports package declares CONFIG_BT_HCIVHCI as a kernel dependency.
bluebinder opens /dev/vhci and proxies HCI packets between Binder and Linux VHCI.
The packaged systemd unit orders bluebinder after lxc-android-config and before bluetooth.service.

runtime_gate.processes: exactly one Android Bluetooth HAL, one bluebinder, and one bluetoothd
runtime_gate.binder: exactly one IBluetoothHci/default registration with zero restarts
runtime_gate.devices: /dev/vhci exists before bluebinder; exactly one internal HCI controller exists after bluebinder
runtime_gate.functional: pair, integrity-checked transfer, controller reset/reconnect, and cold-boot reconnect
